elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M where vendor processes Customer Data
elements.evidence: cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 where Garman processes Sparkling data

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: workers' compensation insurance as required by law
Garman shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request

elements.element: Obligation sits on Vendor and runs for the term
elements.evidence: Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement
errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 (exceeds USD 1M floor)
cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 (exceeds USD 2M floor)

reasons: The document contained no insurance covenant; a single concise new sub-clause (k) was inserted, leaving the entire-agreement paragraph (j) untouched and effective.

All preferred atomic limits are express: CGL USD 1M/occurrence and USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M conditioned on processing of Customer data, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request.
No extra scope was added beyond the position — no additional insureds, waiver of subrogation, notice-of-cancellation or post-termination tail, consistent with the minimality gate.

Minor drafting note only: 'Sparkling data' is lowercase and not a defined term, so it reads descriptively rather than as a defined 'Customer Data'; this does not create a contradiction or dangling mechanic but could be aligned with the Agreement's data terminology.
